notes: No volumes, database or environment: the image serves a static build and drawings live in browser storage.
Share links upload drawings to excalidraw.com, and live collaboration uses its socket server; neither is self-hosted by this recipe.
Self-hosting those services needs a rebuilt frontend plus excalidraw-room and excalidraw-storage-backend, not environment variables.
Latest is intentional: upstream otherwise publishes commit tags, and a static frontend has no data migration.
